Definition: from G4253 and G264; to sin previously (to conversion):--sin already, heretofore sin.
BiblicalUsage: Proamartano means to have sinned already, heretofore. Paul uses it twice for the Corinthians: those who have sinned already and have not repented, and those who heretofore have sinned, to whom he says he will not spare.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe unrepented sin does not fade with time, and Paul's warning is mercy dressed as severity.
